posts.summary:
The Social Security Administration awarded NCS Technologies Inc. a blanket purchase agreement call valued at approximately $10.7 million. The award, signed on September 30, 2026, and released publicly on November 17, 2026, covers the distribution of roughly 6,000 laptops to direct service components that support public-facing operations. The equipment refresh will support disability adjudication functions across the agency.

The work involves information technology hardware and end-user support services, with the award made through full and open competition. The performance period runs from September 30 through October 30, 2026.

posts.summary:
The Department of the Treasury has awarded a blanket purchase agreement call to QUZARA LLC for computer-related services supporting information technology and telecommunications help desk operations. The award, signed on November 19, 2026, obligates $6,998,478 with a ceiling value of $9,998,478 and runs through February 18, 2027. The work falls under the 8(a) small business set-aside program and was competed among eligible vendors.

The engagement involves tier one and two help desk labor, workspace support, printing and output services, and productivity tools assistance. This award was made through full and open competition and represents specialized technical support services for the department's operations.

posts.summary:
The Securities and Exchange Commission awarded a task order to GOVSMART, INC. under the NASA SEWP V contract vehicle for information technology and telecommunications services. The task order, signed on November 17, 2026, carries an initial obligation of $250,000 against a ceiling of $9,852,740 and runs through November 17, 2027. The work involves help desk support, workspace services, and productivity tools classified under other computer-related services.

This task order was set aside for HUBZone small businesses and was awarded following full and open competition after exclusion of other sources. The requirement specifically calls for OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise capabilities to support the agency's technology needs.
